links.outcome: Expert-rated factuality and comprehensiveness of ChatGPT-4 AMD answers; outdated technologies noted
links.effect: 23 (62%) of 37 questions had mean comprehensiveness below 4 and 21 (57%) had factuality below 4; comments flagged superseded or older technologies and techniques not routinely used in practice.
links.quote: Free-text comments highlighted issues related to superseded or older technologies, and techniques that are not routinely used in clinical practice, such as genetic testing.

screen.reason: Expert evaluation of raw ChatGPT-4 outputs on 37 patient FAQs regarding age-related macular degeneration without testing specific guardrails or deployment interventions.
